# Offers and money models: knowledge base

Frameworks for building offers that are hard to say no to, and for sequencing how money comes in.

Based on methods documented by **Alex Hormozi** in *$100M Offers* and *$100M Money Models*. Independent implementation, no affiliation. For the full reasoning behind each framework, read the books ([acquisition.com](https://www.acquisition.com)).

## What is here

| File | Content |
|---|---|
| `02-frameworks-extraidos/frameworks-100m-offers.md` | Value Equation, market selection, the 5-step offer cycle, bonus stacking, guarantees, MAGIC naming |
| `02-frameworks-extraidos/frameworks-100m-money-models.md` | Attraction, upsell, downsell and continuity sequences, payback windows, cash flow structure |
| `03-knowledge-base-rag/kb-principios-regras.md` | Principles on pricing, value, market, offer and sales |
| `03-knowledge-base-rag/kb-conceitos-definicoes.md` | Concepts and definitions, for semantic search |
| `03-knowledge-base-rag/kb-exemplos-aplicados.md` | Applied examples |
| `04-prompt-templates/` | System prompts for the 6 specialist agents in this base |

## Agents

`offer-builder`, `money-model-architect`, `pricing-consultant`, `downsell-agent`, `guarantee-strategist`, `offer-naming`
